array.string: set -a; . /etc/mdm-targetd/mdm-targetd.env; set +a; cd /opt/meerkat-mobkit/examples; exec npx tsx 004-mdm-console-pack/src/targetd.ts --id "$MDM_TARGET_ID" --name "$MDM_TARGET_NAME" --site "$MDM_TARGET_SITE" --platform "${MDM_TARGET_PLATFORM:-darwin}" --transport "${MDM_TARGET_TRANSPORT:-control}" --listen "${MDM_TARGET_LISTEN:-0.0.0.0:5792}" --advertise-url "$MDM_TARGET_ADVERTISE_URL" --kennel "$MDM_KENNEL_URL" --state-dir "${MDM_TARGET_STATE_DIR:-/var/lib/mdm-targetd}" --kennel-auth-token "$MDM_AUTH_TOKEN" --control-auth-token "$MDM_TARGET_AUTH_TOKEN" --allow-shell
